reason: This plugin is primarily a DSH Web UI utility that lets users manage sessions through UI additions: adding delete controls in session rows and a separate archived-session manager. It also performs persistence-side restore/delete operations via registered host commands, so it is best described as UI-focused session lifecycle management with file-backed session data handling. Potentially destructive actions are manual and explicitly permanent per README.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的会话管理，在会话菜单和侧边栏提供入口，可查看归档会话并进行恢复或永久删除操作。
summaries.en: This plugin provides session-management actions in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, adding session menu controls and an archived-sessions window to restore or permanently delete sessions.

capabilities: Adds UI controls to session menus and sidebar to trigger session deletion/restoration actions
Registers host-side DSH commands for delete/restore/permanent-delete flow
Archives sessions from the workspace UI before removal operations
Removes persisted session log directories via persistence APIs

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a Delete session item to each session row menu and a View archived sessions button on the toolbar, and opens a DSH-native modal for restore/delete operations.
README describes host-side commands (/dsh-delete-session, /dsh-archived-restore, /dsh-archived-delete) and that deletion removes persisted JSONL directories via sessionPersistence.locate.
package.json declares dependencies on dsh-session and dsh-session-persistence modules, indicating integration with session and persistence management flows.
